THEINSATIABLE-DESERT_STONE_RELIC.title: Desert Stone
THEINSATIABLE-DESERT_STONE_RELIC.descrip: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Sandstone[/gold] to your hand and apply [blue]{QuickSandPower}[/blue] [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-DESERT_STONE_RELIC.flavor: The Insatiable Sandworm's treasure, said to come from an equally mysterious eternal realm...
THEINSATIABLE-POLISHED_DESERT_STONE_RELI:
At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Sandstone[/gold] to your hand.
At the start of the first [blue]4[/blue] turns of each combat, apply [blue]{QuickSandPower}[/blue] [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
A carefully polished Desert Stone, the source of the Insatiable Sandworm's power.
THEINSATIABLE-REVERSE_HOURGLASS_RELIC.de: Whenever you apply [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to an enemy, increase the [gold]Quicksand[/gold] applied by [blue]{QuickSandPower}[/blue].
THEINSATIABLE-REVERSE_HOURGLASS_RELIC.fl: The sand within seems to defy gravity, flowing grain by grain from the bottom of the hourglass to the top.
THEINSATIABLE-ANOTHER_STOMACH_RELIC.desc: Whenever a non-minion enemy dies to [gold]Swallow[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
THEINSATIABLE-EXUVIAE_SKELETON_RELIC.des: The first attack damage greater than [blue]9[/blue] received each combat is reduced to [blue]9[/blue].
THEINSATIABLE-EXUVIAE_SKELETON_RELIC.fla: Similar shells can often be found in the Burrow. Whether they are molted skins or corpses of exoskeleton creatures, no one knows.
THEINSATIABLE-OBELISK_RELIC.title: Obelisk
THEINSATIABLE-OBELISK_RELIC.description:
Cards with [gold]Innate[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. 
Cards with [gold]Retain[/gold] gain [gold]Innate[/gold].
